column1: # QA-R4 category "proper-nouns" (spec/04-quality-release.md): names and place names of Viet Nam, including
# ethnic-minority and loan forms (spec/01-engine.md 3.3, 3.12, ENG-R331, ENG-R333, ENG-R843, REG-08), each
# typed word by word and committed by a space, with the 13.9 fixture resources.
# Source and licence (CLR-R6): the names are those of provinces, cities and districts in the official
# register of administrative units of Viet Nam (General Statistics Office, danhmuchanhchinh.gso.gov.vn).
# The register is a state administrative document, which Article 15 of the Law on Intellectual Property
# (2005) excludes from copyright protection, and place names are facts: public domain. The spellings were
# typed by hand for this file; no word list was copied.
# Keys: the canonical order of ENG-T02 O1, produced with Scripts/vietnamese-keys.py and then reviewed.
# Rows PN2xx were written by hand: names whose Telex spelling has a transform letter where the name has a
# plain letter need the escape of 4.7 (`Kar` is typed `Karr`, VNI needs nothing), and names outside Tier B
# (`Păh`, `Tẻh`: coda h) commit as typed unless the user keep-Vietnamese list holds them (ENG-R334). Names
# with the onsets f, j, w (for example Cư Jút) cannot compose by the decision in 3.3 and are not listed.
# Columns: id, method, options, keys, expected (whole field), restore (- not checked), note.
# Keys: TSV escapes \s space, \n Return, \t Tab; markers ⌫ Backspace, ⎋ restore toggle, ⟲ reset.

column7: Kar: the r is a tone key in Telex, doubled to escape (4.7, L4 keeps the escaped form)
VNI letters are plain letters (ENG-R403): no escape
apostrophe is a boundary (ENG-R333); gar needs the escape
Ana: a circumflex key after the coda (ENG-R431) is escaped by doubling
ENG-R333: M and Đrắk compose on their own; đr cluster and k coda are Tier B (L6 keeps)
Păh is outside Tier B (coda h): kept by the user list (L2, ENG-R334)
without the user list, Păh is invalid and restored (L5)
all capitals (ENG-R332: case carries no signal)
